figurative_meaning_en: To force oneself into a sitting position or to occupy a place stubbornly
example_sentences_in_bangla: সভায় সবাই চলে গেলেও সে চেপে বসে রইল।
এই চাকরিতে সে চেপে বসেছে, সরতে চায় না।
example_sentences_in_english: Even after everyone left the meeting, he sat there stubbornly.
He has planted himself in this job and refuses to budge.
note: This idiom reflects Bengali cultural emphasis on tenacity in social or positional contexts.
